medial_match — 3D medial op

• Data kinds: voxel × voxel → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.medial_match(vol_a, vol_b, w_topology=0.6, w_radius=0.4, n_bins=12) (to call the implementation directly, import medial; medial.medial_match(vol_a, vol_b, w_topology=0.6, w_radius=0.4, n_bins=12); from the registry, ops3d.get("medial_match"))

Usage

A coarse matching score between two voxel shapes based on their medial (topology + radius distribution). Returns [0,1].

Combines, with weights, the distance between the skeletons' topology descriptors (fractions of endpoint/branch/normal/isolated) and the distance between the medial radius distributions (histograms of inscribed radii), and returns similarity = 1 - distance. The closer to 1, the more similar. Roughly invariant to translation and rotation (90 degrees); used for topology-based initial matching (coarse screening).

Args:

vol_a, vol_b: binary voxels (bool / 0-1 3D).

w_topology: weight of the topology distance (default 0.6).

w_radius: weight of the radius-distribution distance (default 0.4).

n_bins: number of bins of the radius histogram.

Returns:

float: similarity score [0,1] (larger is more similar).
